comments.text: Added in v1.3.1! You can now choose Red, Blue or a custom rope color. Install PbzModConfig and its UE4SS dependency, then open Mods → Quest & Exploration Navigation → Rope color in the game settings. Changes save automatically. Thanks for the suggestion! PbzModConfig: https://www.nexusmods.com/phantombladezero/mods/173
已在1.3.1加入，红色、蓝色和自定义颜色都能选了。安装PbzModConfig及其UE4SS依赖后，在游戏设置的Mods页打开“任务与探索导航”→“绳子颜色”即可，修改后自动保存。感谢建议！ PbzModConfig：https://www.nexusmods.com/phantombladezero/mods/173
